.engramdb/memories/tax-uses-round-half-even_01a0fa09-f984-7372-af23-efbe56dc506a.md:15:Tax amounts are rounded with banker's rounding (`decimal.ROUND_HALF_EVEN`), as decided with the finance team in March 2026. Do not use ROUND_HALF_UP.

Tax uses banker's rounding, `decimal.ROUND_HALF_EVEN`. The finance team decided this in March 2026, and the project's memory says not to use `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

I couldn't confirm this in the code. A search for `ROUND_`, `quantize` and `round(` found matches only in the memory file itself. Either the tax code isn't in this repo yet or it rounds some other way. I'm relying on the recorded decision, not on anything the code does.
